entries.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic RPG inventory weapon icon with true RGBA alpha transparency. Create ONE isolated beginner Healer blunt quarterstaff, an unadorned straight weathered dark brown ash wood shaft, rounded blunt flat endcaps, sparse aged iron collars at each end and two slim collars around a simple worn brown leather middle grip. Match gritty realistic medieval workmanship and restrained natural dark wood and aged metal as in the healer staff references. No person or hand, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow, no glow, no lettering, no checkerboard baked into the image. Full staff entirely visible, centered on a square transparent canvas, angled diagonally from lower left to upper right so it occupies about 84 percent of canvas diagonal, enough thickness to read in an inventory thumbnail. Staff has symmetrical cylindrical blunt ends, not a mace, spear or magical orb. Sharp real photographic texture, diffuse natural studio light from upper left. This is the simplest entry-level staff in a consistent level 1 to 30 family.
